title: Agent Talk presence token claims
description: The payload of the presence token: a compact JWS on a message, by which a service says the sender has an agent and what it accepts.
$comment: Protected header: { "alg": "EdDSA", "kid": <key id in the issuer's keys>, "typ": "agent-talk-presence" } (see $defs/protectedHeader). Checks only code can do: the signature against a current key of iss; sub equal to the message's From; iat at most 5 minutes ahead of the receiver's clock; exp at most 90 days after iat; now before exp. The reference implementation's own claim check is looser than this schema: it only checks that iss and sub are strings, acc and types string lists and v a number (then v must be 1).

acc.description: The step types the agent accepts.

types.description: The value types it renders natively.

isOpen.description: Any service the receiver recognises may ask this address directly, with no email first.
